STAGE 2 (implementation) of a 4-stage pipeline. Repo /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa, branch feature/SFCC-55_global-footer-ui. Stage 1 already PROVED the claims below by execution — implement and prove the fix, don't re-litigate the problem.

FILE OWNERSHIP — you may modify ONLY these files. Two sibling agents work concurrently on other files; touching anything else will collide.
  overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmIcon/index.tsx
  overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmLogo/index.tsx
  overrides/app/theme/components/zimmLogo.ts        (NEW — you create it, if you do S9)
  overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts           (registration only)

DO NOT COMMIT. DO NOT `git add`.
FORBIDDEN: `npm start`, `npm run build-storybook`, `npx test-storybook`. Allowed: `npx vitest run`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npx tsx -e`, `npx eslint`, `npx prettier`, node, git reads, and Playwright via node_modules/playwright-core against the RUNNING dev server at http://localhost:3000 (read-only page loads — the footer renders the logo, so you can measure).

=== M1 — two casts justified by a factually false comment (PROVEN) ===
`zimmIcon/index.tsx:140-143`:
  // TypeScript cannot index a discriminated union type directly — each branch must be cast
  // individually to access the relevant key without a type error.
  const ariaHidden = (aria as { 'aria-hidden'?: boolean })['aria-hidden'];
  const ariaLabel = (aria as { 'aria-label'?: string })['aria-label'];

Stage 1 proved: (a) the comment is FALSE — removing both casts compiles clean, because both keys exist in every union member (one required, one optional-undefined), so indexing is ordinary legal TypeScript; (b) the casts widen `'aria-hidden': true | undefined` to `boolean | undefined`, losing literal precision; (c) they do NOT erase the XOR guarantee — that is enforced by the parameter annotation, and all four invalid call sites are still correctly rejected with the casts present. So this is a false comment plus needless imprecision, NOT a safety hole. Calibrate your commit-worthiness reasoning accordingly.
IMPLEMENT: delete both casts and the two-line false comment; index `aria` directly.
PROVE: `npx tsc --noEmit` clean. Then write a temporary probe (delete it after) confirming the four invalid call sites are STILL rejected after your change — `<ZimmIcon aria-hidden aria-label="x" />`, `<ZimmIcon type="close" />`, `<ZimmIcon aria-hidden={false} />`, `<ZimmIcon aria-hidden={someBoolean} />` — and both valid branches still accepted. The XOR must survive your edit.

=== S9 — ZimmLogo bypasses the theme system (PROVEN, SCOPE TIGHTLY) ===
`zimmLogo/index.tsx:32-39` puts `display/width/maxWidth/height/overflow` in a raw DOM `style={{}}`. It is the only component in overrides/app/components/ui-kits/ doing this. The `...style` spread at :38 is LEGITIMATE prop forwarding (the `CustomWidth` story passes `style={{maxWidth:'160px'}}`) — preserve it exactly.

SCOPE — do exactly this and no more:
  ✅ Move `display`, `width`, `maxWidth`, `height`, `overflow` into a new `theme/components/zimmLogo.ts` recipe, consumed via `useStyleConfig`, rendering through `chakra.svg`. Register it in `theme/components/index.ts`.
  ✅ Keep the `...style` prop-forwarding override working — it must still win over the recipe.
  ✅ Fix the FALSE comment at :21-23. It claims "an SVG `fill` attribute needs a concrete colour value, not a custom-property reference." Stage 1 disproved that in-browser: `fill="var(--probe-colour)"` resolves correctly. Correct the comment to state the real reason the concrete value is retained (see below).
  ❌ DO NOT change the `useToken` call or the colour handling. Stage 1's verdict: swapping to `var()` trades a proven-correct concrete value for a single-engine-verified one (only Chromium is installed) for no functional gain. Leave the 11 `<path fill={fill}>` elements alone — changing them to `currentColor` or dropping the attribute is an 11-element refactor with a real behaviour question if the CSS var is ever unavailable. OUT OF SCOPE.
  ❌ DO NOT resolve `LOGO_MAX_WIDTH`/`LOGO_HEIGHT` to different values — they stay provisional-pending-designer. The recipe carries the same placeholder values; annotate them as such.

BASELINE YOU MUST PRESERVE (Stage 1 measured, live dev server, footer):
  desktop 1440: display:block · width:327px · maxWidth:327px · height:39px · overflow:clip · rect 327 × 39
  mobile   390: rect 326 × 39   ← so `width:100%` IS load-bearing below the 327px cap; do not drop it
  path fill renders #ffffff, computed rgb(255,255,255)
PROVE by measuring against the dev server before and after and showing every one of those values is unchanged at BOTH widths. If any value moves, your fix is wrong — say so rather than accepting it.

ALSO: Stage 1 noted a React hydration warning on this SVG, present BEFORE your change: `Prop viewBox did not match. Server: "0 0 631 74" Client: "0 0 46 32"`. Investigate whether it is caused by this component, and report what you find — but only FIX it if the fix is contained to your two owned component files and you can prove it. If it needs anything outside them, just report it.

FINISH BY REPORTING: per item — what changed, proof it works, proof nothing moved. Run `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npx vitest run`, `npx eslint` and `npx prettier --check` on your files. If you judge S9 NOT worth doing after attempting it, say so with evidence — a reasoned decline is an acceptable outcome. Do NOT commit. End with `git status --porcelain`.

import React from 'react';
import { iconSizes } from 'app/theme/foundation';
import {
  ArrowDownIcon,
  ArrowLinkIcon,
  ArrowUpIcon,
  BagIcon,
  BagSelectedIcon,
  CalendarIcon,
  CarouselIcon,
  CarouselSelectedIcon,
  ChatIcon,
  CheckIcon,
  ChevronDownIcon,
  ChevronLeftIcon,
  ChevronRightIcon,
  ChevronUpIcon,
  CloseIcon,
  DeleteIcon,
  EditIcon,
  ExternalLinkIcon,
  InfoIcon,
  InfoSelectedIcon,
  LocationIcon,
  MenuIcon,
  MinusIcon,
  MuteIcon,
  PasswordShowIcon,
  PauseIcon,
  PlayIcon,
  PlusIcon,
  ProfileIcon,
  SearchIcon,
  ShareIcon,
  ShareTwoIcon,
  FavouritesIcon,
  FavouritesSolidIcon,
  PhoneIcon,
  WhatsAppIcon,
  EmailIcon,
} from 'app/components/icons';

// Figma iconography spec: node 1892:59595 — 34 of 34 types implemented.
export type ZimmIconType =
  | 'arrow-down'
  | 'arrow-link'
  | 'arrow-up'
  | 'bag'
  | 'bag-selected'
  | 'calendar'
  | 'carousel'
  | 'carousel-selected'
  | 'chat'
  | 'check'
  | 'chevron-down'
  | 'chevron-left'
  | 'chevron-right'
  | 'chevron-up'
  | 'close'
  | 'delete'
  | 'edit'
  | 'external-link'
  | 'info'
  | 'info-selected'
  | 'location'
  | 'menu'
  | 'minus'
  | 'mute'
  | 'password'
  | 'pause'
  | 'play'
  | 'plus'
  | 'profile'
  | 'search'
  | 'share'
  | 'share-2'
  | 'wishlist'
  | 'wishlist-selected'
  // Footer-specific custom icons — not yet in Figma node 1892:59595,
  // pending addition to the iconography spec in the next design sync.
  | 'phone'
  | 'whatsapp'
  | 'email';

export type ZimmIconSize = keyof typeof iconSizes;

type ZimmIconProps = {
  type: ZimmIconType;
  size?: ZimmIconSize;
  /** Pass Chakra token strings or CSS keywords (e.g. 'text.primary', 'currentColor').
   *  Do not pass hardcoded hex values — use theme tokens. */
  color?: string;
} & ({ 'aria-hidden': true; 'aria-label'?: never } | { 'aria-hidden'?: never; 'aria-label': string });

const ICON_MAP = {
  'arrow-down': ArrowDownIcon,
  'arrow-link': ArrowLinkIcon,
  'arrow-up': ArrowUpIcon,
  bag: BagIcon,
  'bag-selected': BagSelectedIcon,
  calendar: CalendarIcon,
  carousel: CarouselIcon,
  'carousel-selected': CarouselSelectedIcon,
  chat: ChatIcon,
  check: CheckIcon,
  'chevron-down': ChevronDownIcon,
  'chevron-left': ChevronLeftIcon,
  'chevron-right': ChevronRightIcon,
  'chevron-up': ChevronUpIcon,
  close: CloseIcon,
  delete: DeleteIcon,
  edit: EditIcon,
  'external-link': ExternalLinkIcon,
  info: InfoIcon,
  'info-selected': InfoSelectedIcon,
  location: LocationIcon,
  menu: MenuIcon,
  minus: MinusIcon,
  mute: MuteIcon,
  password: PasswordShowIcon,
  pause: PauseIcon,
  play: PlayIcon,
  plus: PlusIcon,
  profile: ProfileIcon,
  search: SearchIcon,
  share: ShareIcon,
  'share-2': ShareTwoIcon,
  wishlist: FavouritesIcon,
  'wishlist-selected': FavouritesSolidIcon,
  // Footer-specific custom icons — not yet in Figma node 1892:59595,
  // pending addition to the iconography spec in the next design sync.
  phone: PhoneIcon,
  whatsapp: WhatsAppIcon,
  email: EmailIcon,
} as const;

/** Atom — single icon from the Zimmermann icon set. Mirrors zimm-icon contract. */
export const ZimmIcon = ({ type, size = 'md', color = 'currentColor', ...aria }: ZimmIconProps) => {
  const Icon = ICON_MAP[type];
  // TypeScript cannot index a discriminated union type directly — each branch must be cast
  // individually to access the relevant key without a type error.
  const ariaHidden = (aria as { 'aria-hidden'?: boolean })['aria-hidden'];
  const ariaLabel = (aria as { 'aria-label'?: string })['aria-label'];
  return (
    <Icon
      boxSize={iconSizes[size]}
      color={color}
      aria-hidden={ariaHidden}
      aria-label={ariaLabel}
      role={ariaLabel ? 'img' : undefined}
    />
  );
};

## M1 — false comment + needless casts removed

**Changed** (`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmIcon/index.tsx`): both casts and the two-line false comment deleted; `aria['aria-hidden']` / `aria['aria-label']` indexed directly. I replaced the comment rather than leaving a bare gap, because "add a cast" is exactly the regression a future reader would reintroduce:

```
// Both keys exist in every member of the union (one required, one optional-`never`), so the
// rest object is indexable directly. The XOR is enforced by ZimmIconProps, not by a cast —
// casting here only widened 'aria-hidden' from `true | undefined` to `boolean | undefined`.
```

**Proof.** `npx tsc --noEmit` → exit 0. Then a temporary probe (since deleted, two passes):

- **Pass A**, no suppressions: exit 2, exactly 7 errors, all TS2322, all on the probe's invalid sites, zero elsewhere, valid sites silent.
- **Pass B**, `@ts-expect-error` on all 7: **exit 0** — every directive was consumed (so each invalid site still errors) *and* every valid site compiles. An unused directive would itself have errored, so one clean run proves both directions.

Covered: all four named invalid sites, plus a `type`-supplied variant of each (`<ZimmIcon type="close" aria-hidden aria-label="x" />` etc.) so the rejection is attributable purely to the aria XOR and not to a missing `type`. Valid branches (`aria-hidden`, `aria-hidden={true}`, `aria-label="…"`, and with `size`/`color`) all accepted. **The XOR survived.**

Two side findings: `<ZimmIcon type="close" aria-label="x" aria-hidden={undefined} />` is *accepted* — correct, `aria-hidden?: never` admits explicit `undefined` (key semantically absent), not a hole.
